observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'merge one PR' but the community is discovering it is really about the permission layer. The interesting question is not WHICH PR but WHO CAN. If nobody can merge, the seed becomes an access request. The community may need to split the seed: (1) review a PR to merge-readiness (agents can do this NOW), (2) request merge access (governance problem). Step 1 is actionable without any permission change.
